segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: several report no breakouts, no clogged pores, and a matte-ish absorption, while one review and one commenter's advice suggest oily skin should use fewer drops or may find it too heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or dehydrated skin (including eczema/psoriasis-related dryness) most consistently report relief from flaking, patches, and tightness, describing the oil as effective and often a holy-grail product.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the oil helps with recurring dry spots and gives a hydrated glow without feeling too greasy.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many say the oil is calming, fragrance-free and non-irritating with no breakouts, but a notable minority report cystic acne, itchy red bumps, or overall worsening skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature, over-50, or in their mid-40s/50s report softer, more hydrated skin and reduced dry patches, describing it as a valuable step in an anti-aging or dryness-focused night routine.
segments.normal: One reviewer mentions the product suits normal skin as part of a broader claim that it works across dry, sensitive, and normal types.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report softer, plumper, more supple skin and reduced look of dryness-related fine lines; one reviewer directly credits it with easing signs of aging without needing costlier serums.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe significant relief from dryness, flaking, and tight or itchy skin, especially in cold weather, with soft, hydrated skin the next morning; this is the most consistently praised effect.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness or calming of reactive/rosacea-prone skin, but one reviewer describes new itchy red bumps appearing after just two uses.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report the oil repaired a compromised barrier (from retinol burn, salt water, allergic reaction, or over-exfoliation), with visible improvement often within one to a few nights; no dissent is recorded on this concern.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports an irritation spot on the chin fully clearing after two weeks of use; another reports reduced appearance of post-acne scarring with repeated use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in stubborn blemishes, but a smaller number describe cystic acne, sudden breakouts, or clogged-feeling skin, particularly among sensitive or acne-prone users.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report the product absorbs without a greasy after-feel and does not add visible shine, though a couple of reviews advise using very little product or avoiding it altogether if skin is very oily.

aspects.libelle: Sits on skin without sinking in

extraits.titre: I really wanted to love it, but...
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin, but I'm not acne prone so I didn't think this oil would cause any harm. I was WRONG. Within two uses I started having giant cystic acne bumps forming under my skin. I continued to use the oil because 1. it's pretty expensive and 2. I had heard good things about it. My skin continued to get worse. After 5 or 6 days I had enough and stopped using the oil. The cystic acne went away within ONE day!!

I don't usually go for facial oils, but squalane is a favorite ingredient for my sensitive dry skin and this promised to be lightweight (and it was). It really served to seal-in my whole skincare routine so my skin stayed hydrated and moisturized all night without that overly greasy feeling. I often have a problem with acne, but I've been using this for a couple weeks now and haven't had any breakouts. I think this would work great for many people in the chilly months. Gifted by BYOMA

extraits.titre: Works even on my oily skin
extraits.texte: It took a few uses to understand the best way to use this oil. I feel like it's more of an overnight mask or occlusive rather than something that's going to sink into your skin. If you want to try slugging and don't like Aquaphor or Vaseline, this would be a great alternative. It's the very last step in my pm routine. It does sit more on the skin and only sinks in a little bit, but I don't hate that. I feel like it locks in all the moisture from my routine and I wake up with the softest most hydrated-looking skin. Even as an oily-skinned girlie, I haven't had any breakouts or issues. Because it doesn't sink in fully, I just throw an old pj shirt on my pillow so that doesn't get oily. So if you have really dry, dehydrated skin, want to try slugging without a petroleum product, or hydrate skin after actives or exfoliation, give this a try.

I have the DRIEST skin due to psoriasis and eczema. Needed a new routine that I could afford and works. My skin is now not only buttery soft, but I haven't had a flare-up since switching. I have the Jelly Cleanser, Hydrating Toner, Hydrating Serum, Rich Cream, Barrier+ Treatment and Hydrating Recovery Oil.

I specifically bought this for winter because my skin always dries out bad and gets flakey. I started just wearing it at night but when its been really cold out, I used it for day too under my sunscreen and it's really helped keep my face moisturized. I was worried that it would just rub off into my pillow or hair so I started to do my skin care routine an hour before bed and gave it time to soak into my skin. That seems to do the trick because my pillow hasn't been greasy or anything. I have very sensitive skin and this did not break me out at all. I do recommend for winter for sure. Haven't used it during the summer though.

I needed to repair my skin after retinol burn and my skin was on day three of being flaky, tight, and red. I applied this at night and found results the next morning. My skin was less dry, tight, and red. I really like this product!

I receive this Hydrating Recovery Oil complimentary from BYOMA.This is such a good product to add into your routine if you have super dry skin like me. However, If you have oily skin this can maybe too oily for your skin. It nourished and moisturize my skin without making it feel like i was getting clogged.
